title: Add 'Unlimited Sessions' display to Premium subscription tier

requirements.summary: Update Premium subscription tier on SubscriptionPackagesPage to prominently display 'Unlimited Sessions' as a key benefit, distinguishing it from Basic and Standard tiers with fixed session counts
acceptanceCriteria: The Premium subscription plan card on SubscriptionPackagesPage displays 'Unlimited Sessions' (or equivalent phrasing) as a listed benefit.
Basic and Standard tiers continue to show their fixed session counts (not 'unlimited').
The 'Unlimited Sessions' label is visually distinct and clearly readable within the plan card.
No other subscription tier incorrectly shows 'unlimited sessions'.
The page renders without errors and the premium plan badge/highlight remains intact.

file_operations.description: Update the Premium subscription tier card to include 'Unlimited Sessions' as a displayed benefit. Modify the plan card's feature list to show 'Unlimited Sessions' for Premium tier while maintaining fixed session count displays (e.g., '10 Sessions', '30 Sessions') for Basic and Standard tiers. Ensure the text is visually distinct and prominent within the Premium plan card. Do not alter pricing, Stripe checkout flow, or session count enforcement logic. This is a display-only change to make the unlimited sessions benefit clear to users browsing subscription options.
